docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres.md:Use PostgreSQL with the [pgvector](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector) and [pg_textsearch](https://github.com/timescale/pg_textsearch) extensions as a Search Toolkit backend. `PostgresStoreIndex` implements `VectorStoreIndex`, `NavigableIndex`, and `PatchableIndex`, so it uses the same pipeline interfaces as the Vespa backend. Provisioning, schema management, and query scoping differ between the backends.
docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores.md:A backend can also expose partial updates without a full re-index by implementing the optional `PatchableIndex` protocol. This protocol can change one metadata value or one chunk's embedding without chunking and indexing the full document again. Implement `patch_chunk` and `patch_document`:
docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores.md:from mistralai.search.toolkit.search import PatchableIndex
docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores.md:class MyVectorStore(VectorStoreIndex):  # also implements PatchableIndex
docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/changelog.md:- Added a **[Postgres search backend](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres)** (`mistralai-search-toolkit-plugins-postgres`) as a second index alongside Vespa. `PostgresStoreIndex` implements [`VectorStoreIndex`](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores) (dense and hybrid search), [`NavigableIndex`](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores#agentic-operations) (`navigate`/`read`/`grep`/`get_chunk`), and [`PatchableIndex`](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores#partial-updates) (partial updates). A `VectorSearchQuery` that carries both `query` and `embedding` runs BM25 (`pg_textsearch`) and HNSW (`pgvector`) retrieval fused by weighted reciprocal rank fusion; the new `PostgresSearchQuery` tunes `vector_weight` / `text_weight` / `rrf_k`. The `PostgresApp` mirrors the Vespa app's `get_search_index(config, collection)` shape, and collections are declared with `PostgresCollectionSchema(collection_name, document_type, embedding_model)`. Requires the `vector` and `pg_textsearch` extensions provisioned in the target database.
docs/studio/search/search-toolkit/changelog.md:- Added a [`PatchableIndex`](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/custom-vector-stores#partial-updates) capability with `patch_chunk` and `patch_document` for partial updates on `DOCUMENT_PER_CHUNK` indices, avoiding a full re-index when only metadata changes.
